changelog: Refresh: verified live API base URL, audio ingestion via audio_url, MCP install path (npx bluecolumn-mcp), OpenClaw integration pattern, current endpoint guidance
summary: Give AI agents persistent semantic memory using the BlueColumn API (bluecolumn.ai). Use when asked to remember, store, recall, or search memory using BlueColumn; when ingesting notes, conversations, documents, or audio into BlueColumn; when querying what an agent has previously stored; or when wiring up BlueColumn memory endpoints (/agent-remember, /agent-recall, /agent-note) in any workflow. Also use when the user mentions their BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*) and wants to store or retrieve information.
